label: Web platforms: Marketplace, Marketing, Services Platform, Identity, Rewards and Support, plus Conversational AI, Uvation Pulse, Atlas CRM, Devops and Design Marketing Development Collab
note: Web-Marketplace Product Catalog (PC) is reported with Web-Marketplace, because the AI-server catalogue work runs across both boards.

programmes.name: Web-Marketplace
programmes.headline: 18 items closed on 6 Oct: six product grid, filter and product page front-end subtasks (MT-1234 to MT-1245), the token-claim clean-up (MT-1405, MT-1406), the category-disable plan (MT-1438) and its performance check, the RMA status timeline (MT-1487) and the user account flow (MT-1498). The URL disposition decision was re-raised as MT-1576. A live chat widget story (MT-1577, 3 subtasks) and seven NVIDIA AI server fixes (PC-146 to PC-152, three done) were added. The catalogue re-check (PC-136) is still in progress. Past due fell from 8 to 4 on 6 Oct and is 5 this morning: the cart, checkout and pricing tests (MT-1543) passed their 6 Oct date.

programmes.name: Web-Marketing
programmes.headline: A chatbot QA bug (MR-1309) with three subtasks and four more page bugs were raised on 6 Oct; two of those were fixed the same day. Open bugs are now 18, none rated. MR-1168 moved to Ready for Prod. The sitemap fix (MR-1199) and 29 Figma fixes are still Ready for Prod and not released, and related products content on the AI Factory pages (MR-1265) is still blocked. 6 items are past due, five of them June tasks in the 'In Prod1' status.

programmes.name: Web-Uvation Services Platform
programmes.headline: Quiet on 6 Oct: two bugs closed (one S2 add-on description issue, USP-4056) and one task was added. The three S1 production bugs (wrong AI Factory prices and a Document API 502) are still in To Do, now due 30 Oct. 31 items are past due and 45 bugs are open, 5 of them S1.

programmes.name: Uvation Conversational AI
programmes.headline: No changes on 6 Oct. Marketplace sign-in for the AI chatbot (UC-225, due 15 Oct) is in progress. The project has 180 open items, but 171 have not been touched in more than 30 days, so most of the 3 Sep agent backlog does not appear in the 30-day figures here. Nothing is past due.

programmes.name: Uvation Pulse

programmes.name: Atlas CRM

programmes.name: Web-Identity

The work depends on Azure AD B2C and Rafay (ID-745, ID-746, ID-747).

programmes.name: Web-Rewards

programmes.name: Web-Support

programmes.name: Devops
programmes.headline: 75 items moved and 47 closed in 30 days, including the Pulse telemetry deployment on dev (IN-1098, 30 Sep). Three items sit in a BLOCKER status: the Azure Virtual Desktop set-up (IN-990) and the Jira and Azure DevOps integration (IN-992), both due end of July, and the production deployment write-up (IN-1074, due 15 Sep). 7 items are past due, including an S1 error-page bug (IN-1111) and the production AKS resize (IN-1126, due 3 Oct). The September 2nd Sprint ended on 30 Sep and is still open.
